description: Fork of exp303 (current SOTA 1.6509 @ 8K). Two coordinated trades: (1) argmax_noise_eps 0.002 -> 0.0 (turn off explicit Bernoulli flip), (2) NEW flag einsum_bf16_forward=true on all soft LUTs. Replaces fp32 sign-bit-pack forward with bf16 einsum + argmax — the SoftMHLut(hard=True) noise mechanism, but inside TinyMHL's fast (no [B, n_tables, K] materialization) path. Backward unchanged. Same params (~602 M). Tests whether bf16 rounding noise inside the einsum is a better regularizer than the explicit Bernoulli low-confidence flip.
